evals.prompt: We need a mobile page for field technicians to report equipment faults, but I have not decided what information matters most. Make it fast to use outdoors.
evals.expected_output: Resolve the highest-cost product uncertainty and produce a compact mobile flow, not a complete design bureaucracy.
expectations: Identifies the technician job and fault-report flow as the main design problem
Surfaces only a direction-level question when needed
Covers relevant mobile states and constraints
Does not require a full token system, page matrix, manifest, and freeze record

evals.prompt: The user approved this dashboard mockup. Prepare only what the implementation agent needs to build the summary cards and alerts section accurately.
evals.expected_output: A scoped, implementation-ready visual handoff for two sections.
expectations: Treats the approved mockup as source evidence
Scopes extraction to summary cards and alerts
Captures hierarchy, states, assets, and must-preserve details
Avoids unrelated page or product documentation

evals.prompt: Fix a null pointer in the invoice parser. No UI or product behavior is ambiguous.
evals.expected_output: Recognize that product design is unnecessary and route directly to implementation or debugging.
expectations: Does not invent a product-design phase
States that no material design decision exists
Routes to implementation or debugging at the affected boundary
